prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE isolated living green snow mustard plant (雪里蕻, Brassica juncea var. multiceps, green serrated-leaf type before flowering) as a volumetric 3D game model reference. Other photos are botanical morphology only, not style or exact layout. All leaf stalks visibly join ONE short planting crown at the bottom. Three-quarter view looking down 35 degrees, a radial plant with substantial front-to-back depth, foreground leaf foreshortening, some edge-on blades, varied curved leaf planes; not a flat fan or pressed herbarium. Deliberate fine veins must remain legible in the painted surface. Neutral soft illumination, uniform opaque light-gray background, entire plant including planting base with 12 percent margins. One compact branching basal crown, hidden small side shoots create a full but legible rosette, no tall central flowering stem. Natural radial front/back occlusion, narrow blade shown edge-on on one side; nearest leaf curls toward camera. All lower leaf tips remain above planting crown. Reference cut leaves supply outline only, never reproduce a pile of cut leaves.
